title: Odd cycles of Fano planes: beyond Fano compositions
claim: (1) Erratum for THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001A, Theorem 4: its conclusion (every non-colourable cubic triple system is a Fano composition, with 7 + 6k points) is false, and its induction overlooked tight-cut contractions that put a point twice on a line. (2) A Fano block (Fano plane minus a line) forces its three ports to one colour, either colour; a line through two ports of one block and one port of another is the inequality between the blocks' colours, twisted at the single port the equality. (3) A cycle of k Fano blocks is a linear connected cubic triple system on 7k points that is not 2-colourable iff k is odd (7, 21, 35, ...); with one twisted connecting line, iff k is even. (4) The twisted 2-cycle (14 points, sign-nonsingular with its twist, |det| = per = 320) is the smallest twisted system (none on at most 13 points, ticket B) and is the one found by SAT; splicing two of them at the twisted incidences gives a non-colourable linear cubic triple system on 27 points. (5) Hence, by the duality of SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001C, the knot has three-fold spaces with 21, 27, 35, ... triangles that are not Fano compositions; the 21-triangle gadgets are exact with lambda(0) = 125. (6) Conjecture: every non-colourable cubic triple system is assembled from Fano blocks by splices and by cycles with an odd number of inequalities, i.e. its tight-cut decomposition consists of Heawood graphs and planar pieces with doubled edges whose faces have length 2 mod 4.
failure_conditions: A Fano block that does not force its ports, or a cycle of blocks whose colourability disagrees with the parity of k.
A twisted cycle whose colourability disagrees with the stated parity, or a 14-point system not isomorphic to the SAT solution.
A 2-colourable 27-point splice, or a dual gadget of a stated system that is not exact at the knot.
A computation that does not reproduce.
foundation_claim_scope: Cubic triple systems with three distinct points per line; their Fano blocks, cycles and splices; the dual three-fold gadgets of the signed not-all-equal knot. Conjecture 5 is not claimed.

validation.status: checked: erratum examples; block lemma exhaustive; cycles k = 1..7 and twisted k = 1..6 by SAT against the core parity; 14-point isomorphism and exact det/per; 27-point system by SAT; 21-triangle gadgets exact at the knot; duality conditions at 27 and 35 points; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: elementary consequences of the block lemma and ticket A's splice calculus; no overlap found (candidate local delta) for the reading as the knot's three-fold spaces; Conjecture 5 is the expected specialization of Robertson-Seymour-Thomas and Kasteleyn
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
